name: Olatech Solutions Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2014, Olatech Solutions Ltd
 is in the business of Data Centre, Enterprise, Telecom, and IT Software solutions in the OSS 
 – BSS segment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) OTSL is in the business of Data Centre, Enterprise, Telecom, and IT Software solutions in the Operations Support System and Business Support System segment. 
b) It provides software solutions and System Integration to its clients and have deployed its software solutions at various institutions in India and abroad. 
c) Company offers services ranging from consultation, architecture, solution design, and implementation to monitoring and providing managed services. 
d) Its software solutions are offered under the registered trademark Epiphany
e) Company has collaborated with clients  across verticals such as Telcos, ISPs, Public Sector Enterprises, Data Centre Service Providers, etc.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 38.8%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 91.3 to 112 days.
